name: Advanced Woocommerce Reporting
author: Devsoul

sections.description:
The WooCommerce Sales Report Plugin is a powerful tool designed to provide in-depth insights into your store’s sales performance. Whether you need a product advanced woocommerce reporting, advanced WooCommerce reporting, or a WooCommerce sales tax report, this plugin simplifies data analysis for better decision-making.

Short Description

Track, analyze, and optimize WooCommerce sales with detailed reports on orders, products, categories, and regions for data-driven decisions

Compatible

  1. Addify Cost Of Goods
  2. Yith Cost Of Goods
  3. Woocommerce Sales Report

Features

  • Sales Analysis for WooCommerce: Track sales trends over different time periods.

  • Sales by Order: View detailed reports on all orders placed.

  • Sales by Product: Analyze profit generated by specific products.

  • Sales by Specific Category: Get category-wise sales performance reports.

  • WooCommerce Sales Report by Product: Identify best-selling products and low-performing items.

  • WooCommerce Sales Report by User Role: Understand how different user roles contribute to sales.

  • Sales by Country and State: Filter reports by geographical location.

  • WooCommerce Daily Sales Report: Monitor daily profit and order trends.

  • WooCommerce Sales Tax Report: Generate tax reports based on sales data.

  • Get cost of goods and profit data through report

  • Hide or Show any column to get your preferred sales data

    Filters Options

  • sale by Order

  • sale by Product
  • Specific Product
  • Specific Category
  • Order Status
  • Select Countries
  • Select States
  • Select Zip Code
  • Generate Sale Tax
  • Generate Daily Sales Report
  • Generate Report by User/ User Role

Want to Try Our Premium Version you can visit below and let us know if anything else in your mind. Email:devsoulofficial@gmail.com

  • WooCommerce Sales Tax Report

Why use this extension

Gain Actionable Sales Insights

*The WooCommerce Sales Report Plugin helps store owners track, analyze, and interpret their sales data effectively. Whether you need reports for sales by product, category, or country, this plugin provides the flexibility to generate detailed insights.

Make Informed Business Decisions

*With advanced WooCommerce reporting, you can identify top-performing products, track sales trends across different geographical locations, and optimize pricing and marketing strategies.

User-Friendly and Customizable

*The plugin offers an intuitive interface, making it easy to filter and customize reports based on your business needs. Whether you want a WooCommerce sales report by user role or a WooCommerce sales tax report, you can generate it with just a few clicks.

How to Use the WooCommerce Sales Report Plugin

Install & Activate: Download the plugin from the WordPress repository and activate it.

Access Sales Reports: Navigate to the WooCommerce Reports section in your dashboard.

Select Report Type: Choose from options such as sales by product, order status, or country.

Filter & Export: Apply custom filters and export data for further analysis.

FAQs

Q: How to get sales report from WooCommerce?

Ans: You can generate a sales report by navigating to WooCommerce > Reports. With our best WooCommerce sales report plugin, you get more advanced reporting options beyond default WooCommerce reports.

Q: How do I report sales by country in WooCommerce?

Ans: Using the WooCommerce Sales Report Plugin, you can filter sales data by country or state to analyze performance across different regions.

Q: How do I track sales in WooCommerce?

Ans: Our advanced WooCommerce reporting feature allows you to track orders, profit, and sales trends in real time.

Q: How to extract sales data from WooCommerce?

Ans: The plugin allows you to export sales reports in CSV format, making it easy to analyze data in external applications.

Contact US

Email us at: devsoulofficial@gmail.com

  • Feel Free to contact Us for support, installation or customization.

External Dependencies

This plugin uses the Google Charts loader library for chart rendering. The library is hosted on Google’s servers and accessed via the following URL: https://www.gstatic.com/charts/loader.js

Google Charts Loader: Used for chart rendering, hosted on Google’s servers.URL: https://www.gstatic.com/charts/loader.js

Font Awesome: Provides icon fonts for styling and UI enhancements.URL: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/4.7.0/css/font-awesome.min.css

DataTables CSS: Styles the DataTables for enhanced table functionality.URL: https://cdn.datatables.net/1.11.5/css/jquery.dataTables.min.css

DataTables JS: Adds interactive table features such as sorting and pagination. URL: https://cdn.datatables.net/1.11.5/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js
sections.installation:
Download the .zip file.
Go to: WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New and Upload Plugin with the file you downloaded with Choose File.
Install Now and Activate the extension.

You can also visit devsouls.store
